name: Unni
overview: The name Unni appears in Scripture as a faithful servant of God during two significant periods in Israel's history. In the time of King David, Unni is listed among the Levites who played musical instruments, specifically psalteries, contributing to the worship and celebration as part of the temple service (1 Chronicles 15:18, 20). Later, during the time of Nehemiah, Unni is mentioned again as a Levite involved in the watch duties, indicating a role in the protection and order of the restored community (Nehemiah 12:9). These references highlight Unni's consistent dedication to the service of God in both worship and communal responsibility.
